document_title: Stage 4.2.8 — PILOT-GATE-01: Pre-Execution Gate, Query Manifest 105 & Path Closure Report

storage.lancedb_path.description: Primary vector store directory path resolved in _db_paths() and passed to VectorStore

storage.metadata_db.description: Primary SQLite metadata database path resolved in _db_paths() and passed to DocumentResolver/SemanticCache

lancedb.uri.dispatch_site: None in runtime dispatch (_db_paths reads only storage.lancedb_path)
lancedb.uri.description: Ignored by production dispatch; alias conflict detection added to validate_pilot_config (fails closed if present and conflicting)

tables.parquet_dir.description: Directory for extracted Parquet tables; validated and loaded if tables enabled

search_cache_and_semantic_cache.description: Table semantic_cache inside metadata.db; uses SQLite connection derived from storage.metadata_db

FLYING_RAG_METADATA_DB.description: Overrides cfg['storage']['metadata_db'] for ShadowEvidenceIntegrityGate in server.py; sanitized/stripped in child subprocess env and checked in check_readonly_scope to prevent production corruption

FLYING_RAG_SHADOW_LOG_PATH.description: Log destination for Shadow EIG events; child processes point to dedicated isolated off.jsonl / on.jsonl

FLYING_RAG_SHADOW_CONTROL_FILE.description: Dynamic control file path for shadow toggle in server.py

FLYING_RAG_CONFIG.description: Runtime config path override read by load_config()

temp_logs.description: Ephemeral per-pair directory (pair_NNNN) created in system temp for isolated channel logging

bounded_deadline_analysis.hardware_profile: Acer Aspire (Core i3-2310M @ 2.10 GHz, 4GB RAM, GeForce GT 540M, SATA HDD)
bounded_deadline_analysis.required_mitigation: Explicit operator-configured total_pilot_deadline_sec >= 450.0 required for 105-query pilot; harness cleanly aborts with DEADLINE_EXCEEDED without silent truncation if deadline expires

NG-01.name: test_contract_ng01_max_queries_105_on_8_set_does_not_yield_105_pass
NG-01.description: Passing max_queries=105 to default 8-query suite must NOT yield 105 queries or REAL_PILOT_PASS

NG-02.name: test_contract_ng02_invalid_manifest_fails_closed_zero_calls
NG-02.description: Missing, truncated, count mismatch, corrupt UTF-8/JSON manifest fails closed before worker spawn with 0 calls
NG-02.expected: validate_query_manifest fails, runner returns status=CONFIG_INVALID, verdict=BLOCKED, actual_search_calls=0
NG-02.observed: status=CONFIG_INVALID, verdict=BLOCKED, actual_search_calls=0, spy search call_count=0

NG-03.name: test_contract_ng03_synthetic_105_manifest_structure_and_counter_accounting
NG-03.description: Canonical 105 manifest loaded, 105 positions, 210 planned calls, 0 real search calls on offline preflight
NG-03.expected: 105 positions, 80 normative, 25 adversarial, 210 planned calls, actual_search_calls == 0
NG-03.observed: total_queries_planned == 105, normative == 80, adversarial == 25, actual_search_calls == 0, verdict == BLOCKED

NG-04.name: test_contract_ng04_conflicting_or_production_env_override_vetoed
NG-04.description: Conflicting lancedb.uri alias or inherited FLYING_RAG_METADATA_DB pointing to production vetoes search with 0 calls
NG-04.expected: validate_pilot_config rejects conflicting alias; check_readonly_scope returns BLOCKED_READONLY_NOT_PROVEN; 0 calls
NG-04.observed: CONFIG_INVALID on alias conflict; scope=BLOCKED_READONLY_NOT_PROVEN on prod env; actual_search_calls=0

NG-05.name: test_contract_ng05_symlink_or_config_tamper_after_preflight_fails_closed
NG-05.description: Symlink alias or config modification after preflight aborts loop and vetoes GO
NG-05.expected: Runtime fingerprint mismatch breaks loop with CONFIG_TAMPER_DETECTED, verdict=BLOCKED, queries_completed < planned

NG-06.name: test_contract_ng06_unconfirmed_snapshot_or_wal_drift_yields_no_go
NG-06.description: Unconfirmed snapshot, non-zero WAL, or sample hash mismatch yields NO_GO
NG-06.expected: verify_snapshot_readiness rejects non-zero WAL, hash mismatch, or missing manifest with explicit codes

NG-07.name: test_contract_ng07_foreign_pid_on_8089_prevents_kill_and_yields_no_go
NG-07.description: Foreign PID on port 8089 or identity mismatch strictly prevents termination
NG-07.expected: verify_process_termination_safety returns PORT_8089_IN_USE_BY_FOREIGN_PROCESS, 0 process termination attempts
NG-07.observed: PORT_8089_IN_USE_BY_FOREIGN_PROCESS returned; foreign PID kill completely rejected

NG-08.name: test_contract_ng08_embedding_failure_or_eig_telemetry_missing_yields_no_go
NG-08.description: Embedding backend offline, model mismatch, missing EIG telemetry, or error payloads yield NO_GO
NG-08.expected: Honest classification: BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY on offline, FAILED on missing telemetry, search_errors incremented on error payload
NG-08.observed: Offline -> BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY; missing telemetry -> FAILED; error payload -> search_errors > 0, verdict != GO

NG-09.name: test_contract_ng09_deadline_exhaustion_terminates_child_without_silent_truncation
NG-09.description: Total pilot deadline exhaustion aborts series cleanly without silent truncation of planned queries

NG-10.name: test_contract_ng10_idempotent_rerun_on_same_head_manifest_stable
NG-10.description: Repeated run on identical HEAD and manifest produces identical fingerprints and stable status
NG-10.expected: Identical verdict, status, total_queries_planned, config_fingerprint, manifest_sha256 across repeated runs
NG-10.observed: Identical verdict (BLOCKED), status (BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY), total_queries_planned (105), fingerprints match 100%
